after: round 2 development on the 50 PL-900 buildings (both judges read); before the fresh locked set was drawn or any of its lidar cropped
outlines: county outline, cut into its buildings where two or more OSM buildings each overlap it by >= 40 m2 (split_outlines.py); parts under 30 m2 join a neighbour
classes: delivered class 6; only where an outline (or part) has fewer than 50 class-6 points, also non-ground points >= 2 m above the ground beside it on RANSAC planes (0.12 m, <= 60 deg, >= 6 m2 at >= 3 pts/m2)
evidence: an outline or part whose class-6 points fill under 40% of its 1 m cells is left out of both measured arms and counts against usable
height_only: outline extruded from the 5th-percentile ground within 4 m to the 70th percentile of roof points, per part
holdout: 2 m patches, one in five withheld, hash of patch position
appearance: PL-881 hybrid atlas at 82336461, walls by recorded wall material, all up-facing faces shingle, no openings or trim in any arm

tolerances.geometry_pass: arm 3 fitted without the withheld patches: median |error| <= 0.5 m and >= 75% of withheld roof points within 1 m
tolerances.ridge_eave: within 1.0 m of the withheld points' 99th percentile (ridge) and 5th percentile near the outline (eave), where at least 8 edge points exist
tolerances.topology: blind judge, from the 2025 orthoimage and lidar surface: dominant roof form right and ridge within 30 degrees, on >= 80% of judgeable buildings
tolerances.preference: blind A/B, arm 3 preferred over arm 2 on >= 70%, ties counted separately, city and close views scored apart
tolerances.usable_lod2: every part returns standard-mode LoD2.2 with no per-building change and the joined model passes geometry_pass; target >= 80% of attempts

judges: first: Claude Sonnet, A/B (LoD2 vs height-only, city and close) and roof form; second: Claude Opus told to take longer, A/B only; ties count as non-wins
